name: wirekit
description: Wirekit — Balsamiq-sketch wireframe design system. Reusable HTML + CSS + block library for mid-fi wireframes. Referenced by wireframing skill (and optionally others). Classless pattern — semantic HTML styled via data-region / data-state / data-placeholder attributes. SVG wavy-border filter for hand-drawn feel. Vendored webfonts (Caveat + Patrick Hand). Print-friendly. Not a skill — a library.
